title: MEIKO — MORE MORE Training!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(They're all working hard again today.
I can tell that they want to do well in the grand prix.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wish I could somehow provide them with more support...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that felt better compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, let's end our group practice here.
We'll call it a day and each work on the finishing touches independently.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'll practice stopping on a dime for that part where my movements go too far.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also had some trouble with certain steps, so I'll work on mastering them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hi, girls!
There's something I'd like to ask all of you...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've finished doing my research, I'm all set to go.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: MEIKO's Friendly Advice Service is open for business!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And my first customer will be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, can I help you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You said the other day that you were having trouble coming up with new workouts for everyone, remember?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I took the liberty of coming up with some ideas based on that book you showed me. Here, take a look...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. You're saying that we should try incorporating some Pilates into our usual exercises?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. By making your bodies more limber through Pilates, I believe you'll be able to expand your range of motion and get more out of your strength workouts.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You said that you'd like to make your legs look more elegant, yes, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. We dance like ballerinas for this one song, but I look so clumsy during certain parts.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You need to have both flexibility and very strong ankles in order to dance like that. And you can't just focus on your legs. It's going to involve your entire body.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's start by figuring out what you need to work on the most.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were having trouble with these steps, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...!
You performed that so smoothly and precisely.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
There's a few tricks to that.
Let's start by going over the basic components together!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're trying to find a way to stop on a dime during dances, yes, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I've gotten a lot better at it, but I'm still struggling to stop during faster songs...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do I just need to keep strengthening my core...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your core is important, but you should be okay on that front already. The problem may have to do with how and when you flex your muscles.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everything will start falling into place once you get the hang of it. We'll start with a lesson on how to use your upper body properly♪
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow.
We're moving so much better as a group now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I have MEIKO to thank for showing me how to master those steps.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also have MEIKO to thank. I can move my legs more freely after doing those stretches she showed me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Now that I know how to use my muscles more properly, I've gotten a much better grasp of things!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I'd say our new workouts have also begun bearing fruit. I feel like we're all moving with a lot more balance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I was able to help them.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (However, as long as they continue being idols, they'll always have worries. So...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: MEIKO's Friendly Advice Service is still open for business! Feel free to come ask me about any problems you have♪
